Extract catch (landings) time series from Atlantis outputs

extract_catch_main.Rd

When fishery is active, reads the _Catch_FC variables from the catch NetCDF file and sums across all fleet dimensions for each species. When fishery is inactive, returns a zero-filled list for every functional group.

Usage

extract_catch_main(path, prefix = NULL, fg.file, dt.timeserie, fishery, ...)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the directory containing Atlantis outputs.

prefix

Character. Prefix of the Atlantis configuration (e.g. "AMPS").

fg.file

Character. Path to the functional groups CSV file.

dt.timeserie

Integer. Number of time steps in the run, used to size the zero-filled catch vectors when fishery = FALSE.

fishery

Logical. Whether the fishery module was activated in this Atlantis run.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused).

Value

A named list with one element per functional group. Each element is a numeric vector of total catch summed across all fleets, one value per time step. Returns zeros for all groups when fishery = FALSE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  catch <- extract_catch_main(
    path         = "path/to/atlantis/outputs",
    prefix       = "AMPS",
    fg.file      = "PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups.csv",
    dt.timeserie = 50,
    fishery      = TRUE
  )
} # }
